label: post-tool-call-hook-fix-apr8
context:
CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED:

The distillation plugin's post_tool_call hook was registered but NEVER called from the agent runtime. Both concurrent and sequential tool execution paths in run_agent.py had tool_complete_callback but no invoke_hook("post_tool_call", ...).

This means the entire feedback loop was broken:
- Tips injected (pre_llm_call) ✓
- API usage tracked (post_api_request) ✓  
- Tip outcome feedback (post_tool_call) ✗ — NEVER FIRED

SAGE reward, condition-aware voting, mythos cycle detection, behavior calibration, trajectory metrics — ALL were running on simulated data only, never real tool outcomes.

FIX: Added invoke_hook("post_tool_call", ...) to both:
1. _execute_tool_calls_concurrent (L6245, after tool_complete_callback)
2. _execute_tool_calls_sequential (L6559, after tool_complete_callback)

Both patches pass lint. Gateway restart needed to activate.

Tip DB: 1154 tips, 0.8528 avg
Gateway PID: 11926 (needs restart)
Danny at test.
